Now that we've had a solid period of time to see the Chimera settle in the meta, it's outperforming some of the longer ranged weapons at distance, which was not intended. These adjustments should nudge it more towards the mid-range bracket.
Disabled trigger-hold delay on pump action

When the player holds down the trigger after firing a manual action or pump action weapon, like a number of other FPS games, this blocks the action until the trigger is released, allowing some additional control for the player. We feel this is something that is rarely being used intentionally though, and it can have a hidden negative impact on players who are slower at pressing the fire button as it slightly slows their rate of fire due to briefly blocking the action. We've removed this blocking on all pump action shotguns to give a smoother and more consistent experience.
